# listmonk_list_role (Resource)

Manages a listmonk list role: per-list permissions that can be assigned to users in addition to their user role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "listmonk_list" "newsletter" {
  name = "Newsletter"
}

resource "listmonk_list" "events" {
  name = "Events"
}

resource "listmonk_list_role" "newsletter_editors" {
  name = "Newsletter editors"

  list {
    list_id     = listmonk_list.newsletter.id
    permissions = ["list:get", "list:manage"]
  }

  list {
    list_id     = listmonk_list.events.id
    permissions = ["list:get"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role.

### Optional

- `list` (Block Set) Permissions on one list. Repeat the block for each list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--list))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the role.

<a id="nestedblock--list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `list`

Required:

- `list_id` (Number) ID of the list.
- `permissions` (Set of String) `list:get` and/or `list:manage`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# List roles are imported by their numeric ID.
terraform import listmonk_list_role.newsletter_editors 4
```
